title: Turn every failure into an error response

blocks.text: When something goes wrong inside a server, the other side still needs an answer it can act on, and the operator needs to know which kind of thing went wrong. The page gives each kind of failure its own exception type and maps each type to its own response code. Here you build that mapping and the participant that uses it.

Write `ErrorHandlingParticipant`, a jPOS `TransactionParticipant`. The three exception types are declared for you as nested classes: `ISO8583ParseException`, `TransactionProcessingException` and `NetworkCommunicationException`.
`static ISOMsg errorResponse(Exception failure)` builds the error response: field 39 holds the code and field 63 the message.

items: A parse failure is `01`, a processing failure `02`, a network failure `03`, each with the failure's own message.
Any other failure is `99` with the message `An unexpected error occurred`. Its own text may hold an internal detail (a query, a host name, a key alias) and must never reach the response.

blocks.text: `prepare` reads the request, an `ISOMsg`, from the context entry `REQUEST`:

items: no request is a parse failure, `Invalid or missing ISO message`;
processing code (field 3) `999999` is a processing failure, `Invalid processing code`;
processing code `888888` is a network failure, `Network is unavailable`;
anything else is fine, and `prepare` returns `PREPARED | NO_JOIN`.

blocks.text: On any failure, including one you did not anticipate, `prepare` must not throw. It puts the error response in the context entry `RESPONSE` and returns `ABORTED | NO_JOIN`.

cases.says: a parse, processing or network failure becomes an error response with code 01, 02 or 03 and the failure's message
the participant prepares a good request, and for a missing request or a failing processing code aborts with the error response in the context
an unexpected failure becomes code 99 with a generic message, never the failure's own text
a context holding something that is not an ISOMsg aborts with code 99 instead of throwing out of prepare
